issues.title: 产品灵感日报 · 20 个新品

products.name: The GTM Co-Founder
products.tagline: Open-source GTM skills for technical founders
products.summaryZh: 面向技术创始人的开源GTM技能
products.descriptionZh: 大多数AI开发者工具创始人所得到的销售与营销建议千篇一律，而GTM Co-Founder则不同。它是一套开源技能，先对你进行一次访谈，了解你的真实产品和市场，然后一步步引导你走过一份按优先级排序的GTM路线图：目标用户、定位、首批50名用户、发布、定价等。这套方法基于Adam Frankl和Jakub Czakon的实战手册，以及我作为创始AE和GTM顾问的经验。免费且开源。
products.description: Most AI hands dev-tool founders the same generic sales and marketing advice. The GTM Co-Founder doesn't. It's a set of open-source skills that interview you once, learn your real product and market, then walk you move by move through a prioritised GTM roadmap: who it's for, positioning, your first 50 users, launch, pricing, etc. Grounded in the playbooks of Adam Frankl and Jakub Czakon, plus my own time as a Founding AE and GTM advisor. Free and open source.

products.name: AstraPixels
products.tagline: ​​A pixel-art solar system at its real current positions.​
products.summaryZh: 像素艺术风格的太阳系，呈现其真实当前位置。
products.descriptionZh: 一张太阳系的动画像素艺术地图，每个天体都处于其真实当前位置，基于已公布的轨道要素计算而非从列表复制。从太阳缩放到柯伊伯带，浏览171个已编目天体及其来源事实，并查看未来六个月的天象动态。每块岩石也均可出售：以5美元认领一颗小行星，永久持有，随意命名。此处的名称仅显示在AstraPixels上，并非IAU正式命名。
products.description: An animated pixel-art map of the solar system with every body at its real current position, computed from published orbital elements rather than copied from a list. Zoom from the Sun to the Kuiper belt, browse 171 catalogued objects with sourced facts, and see what the sky is doing for the next six months. Every rock is also for sale: claim an asteroid for $5, keep it forever, name it whatever you like. A name here is shown on AstraPixels only, and is not an IAU designation.

products.name: Hexis
products.tagline: Git-backed skills, tools & context for AI agents
products.summaryZh: 基于Git的技能、工具与上下文，专为AI代理设计
products.descriptionZh: 公司AI技能、工具与知识的统一存放之处——集中管理、审核与访问控制，可供任何AI代理使用。Hexis构建于Git之上：保留核心功能（版本控制、拉取请求），并增添简洁的用户体验，使任何人都能使用技能、提出修改建议并提交新技能，管理员则可管控每个人、团队或代理可访问的上下文、工具和技能。通过MCP接入，适用于公司内的任何代理。
products.description: One place where your company's AI skills, tools and knowledge live - centrally managed, reviewed and access-controlled, and usable from any AI agent. Hexis is a layer on top of Git: same core (versioning, PRs), plus a clean UX so anyone can use skills, suggest changes, and submit new ones and admins can govern which context, tools, and skills each person, team, or agent can access. Consumed via MCP, works in any agent in the company.

products.name: Basedash Subscriptions
products.tagline: Subscribe to any dashboard. Delivered on schedule.
products.summaryZh: 订阅任意仪表盘。按计划准时送达。
products.descriptionZh: 订阅任何Basedash仪表板或图表，即可按计划定时获取最新快照——直接发送至您的邮箱或Slack频道。选择节奏（每周一上午9点、每日、每月1号），指定接收人，每次投递都附带最新图表及指向实时仪表板的链接。无需导出、截图或记得分享。您的团队想要的周一指标邮件，无需任何人手动构建。您的仪表板，按时送达。
products.description: Subscribe to any Basedash dashboard or chart and get a fresh snapshot delivered on a schedule—straight to your inbox or a Slack channel. Pick the cadence (every Monday at 9am, daily, monthly on the 1st), choose who receives it, and each delivery arrives with up-to-date charts and a link back to the live dashboard. No exporting, no screenshotting, no remembering to share. The Monday metrics email your team wants, without anyone building it. Your dashboards, delivered on schedule.

products.name: Toolport
products.tagline: Every tool, one port. One MCP setup for all your AI agents
products.summaryZh: 所有工具，一个端口。一套MCP配置，适配所有AI代理。
products.descriptionZh: 一个免费、开源的本地MCP网关。每个服务器只需设置一次，所有AI代理（Claude、Cursor、VS Code、Codex等29个）即可共享。它不将所有工具定义塞入上下文，而是暴露几个元工具，供代理按需搜索。经基准测试和正确性评分，在相同任务成功率下，令牌使用量最多减少91%。密钥存储在操作系统钥匙串中，而非客户端配置。恶意拉盘和工具投毒会被标记，破坏性调用可等待你的批准。
products.description: A free, open source, local MCP gateway. Set up each server once and every AI agent shares it (Claude, Cursor, VS Code, Codex, and 29 more). Instead of dumping every tool definition into context, it exposes a few meta-tools your agent searches on demand. Benchmarked and graded for correct answers, that's up to 91% fewer tokens at the same task success. Secrets live in your OS keychain, not client configs. Rug-pulls and tool poisoning get flagged, and destructive calls can wait for your approval.

products.name: Pocket Fit
products.tagline: AI Workout & Food
products.summaryZh: AI锻炼与饮食
products.descriptionZh: 大多数人会在第三周放弃健身应用。你连续21天做对了一切，镜子里的自己却毫无变化，而应用回馈给你的只是一个数字。Pocket Fit让进步看得见。拍一张照片，AI就能展示你1、2、3乃至6个月后的样子，一个3D虚拟形象会随着你的训练而变化。其下是：自动挑选并逐步进阶的负重训练、拍照记录饮食、肌肉覆盖追踪、情绪、连续打卡记录，以及一群会因你跳过腿部训练日而调侃你的伙伴。由伦敦的两个人打造。
products.description: Most people quit fitness apps in week three. You do everything right for 21 days, the mirror looks identical, and all the app gives back is a number. Pocket Fit makes progress visible. Take one photo and AI shows you 1, 2, 3 and 6 months ahead and a 3D avatar changes as you train. Underneath: workouts with weights auto-picked and progressed, food logged by photo, muscle coverage tracking, mood, streaks, and a crew who roast you for skipping leg day. Built by two people in London.

products.name: Otiumz
products.tagline: AI-powered social app for every side of you
products.summaryZh: 为你的每一面打造的AI社交应用
products.descriptionZh: Otiumz是一款AI驱动的社交应用，适配你的每一面。不同于围绕单一精致身份构建的传统社交应用，它允许你在一个账户下创建多个个人资料（子账户），公开或私密圈内连接，分享动态，发现人群，聊天，以及进行语音或视频通话。创建并训练多个数字分身和AI角色，然后选择一个来驱动对话开场、个性化回复建议，以及在你离开时可选自动回复。
products.description: Otiumz is an AI-powered social app for every side of you. Unlike traditional social apps built around one polished identity, it lets you create multiple profiles (subaccounts) under one account, connect publicly or within private circles, share Moments, discover people, chat, and make voice or video calls. Create and train multiple Digital Selves and AI Characters, then choose one to power conversation starters, personalized reply suggestions, and optional auto-replies while you’re away.

products.name: Pesterly
products.tagline: Automated client document collection that follows up for you
products.summaryZh: 自动收集客户文件，并为您跟进后续事宜。
products.descriptionZh: Pesterly是一款面向Google Workspace的文档收集工具，能将文件清单转化为邮件请求，按固定时间表追踪缺失文件，并将所有上传内容保存到您自己的Google Drive文件夹中。
products.description: Pesterly is a document collection tool for Google Workspace that turns a checklist of files into an email request, chases whatever is still missing on a fixed schedule, and saves every upload into a folder in your own Google Drive.

products.name: Rendemo
products.tagline: Turn any web app into a clickable demo in minutes
products.summaryZh: 将任何Web应用在几分钟内转化为可点击的演示。
products.descriptionZh: Rendemo将你的真实产品屏幕录制转化为可点击浏览的演示，捕获实际HTML而非截图，因此其行为与真实产品一致。使用Chrome扩展录制一次，即可发布可嵌入的演示（一个脚本标签）、MP4视频，或在你实时应用上提供引导式导览。每个套餐均附带MCP服务器，使你的IDE代理能够编写字幕、应用品牌风格、控制视角、进行代码检查、发布，并最终在你的网站上上线。
products.description: Rendemo turns a screen recording of your real product into a demo people can click through, capturing the actual HTML, not screenshots, so it behaves like the real thing. Record once with the Chrome extension. Ship an embeddable demo (one script tag), an MP4, or a guided tour on your live app. It ships an MCP server on every plan, so your IDE Agent can write the captions, apply your brand, direct the camera, lint it, publish, and then its live on your website.

products.name: Arbyn
products.tagline: AI support agent for Shopify that acts on your orders
products.summaryZh: Shopify的AI支持代理，可处理您的订单
products.descriptionZh: Arbyn是Shopify的AI支持与销售代理。它能以你店铺的口吻回复支持邮件和实时聊天，自行更新收货地址，并在你一键批准后处理退款、取消订单、折扣、礼品卡、补发和退货。免费套餐每月包含150次AI对话。无限量使用每月固定99美元，无按工单计费。
products.description: Arbyn is an AI support and sales agent for Shopify. It answers support email and live chat in your store's voice, updates shipping addresses on its own, and handles refunds, cancellations, discounts, gift cards, reships and returns after you approve them with one tap. Free plan with 150 AI conversations a month. $99 a month flat for unlimited. No per ticket fees.

products.name: Mononote
products.tagline: Focus on one note
products.summaryZh: 专注于一条笔记。
products.descriptionZh: 专注一条笔记。在锁屏、主屏幕和灵动岛上展示它。
products.description: Focus on one note. Show it on your Lock Screen, Home Screen, and Dynamic Island.

products.name: TrainZilla
products.tagline: Your fitness coaching business, run by an AI agent.
products.summaryZh: 您的健身教练业务，由AI代理运营。
products.descriptionZh: TrainZilla现在在市场的两端都运行在真正的智能体AI层上：Coach应用内置AI助手，客户端应用内提供AI教练订阅（个性化训练/营养/习惯计划、每周调整、24/7聊天），面向没有教练的用户，以及一个实时MCP服务器（23个工具），供Claude等外部智能体使用。AI不仅聊天，更能行动。
products.description: TrainZilla now runs on a real agentic AI layer on both sides of the marketplace: an AI assistant built into the Coach app, an AI Coach subscription inside the client app (personalised workout/nutrition/habit plans, weekly adjustments, 24/7 chat) for people without a coach, and a live MCP server (23 tools) for external agents like Claude. AI that acts, not just chats.

products.name: Tweet Mockup Generator by MockupTown
products.tagline: Tweet mockups with custom avatars, stats, and features
products.summaryZh: 带自定义头像、统计数据和功能特性的推文样机。
products.descriptionZh: 免费推文模拟器——数秒内生成逼真的X/Twitter推文样机。自定义头像、显示名称、@用户名及认证徽章（蓝色、金色或灰色）。控制浏览量、点赞、回复、转发和收藏。支持单图、2-4图网格或带投票百分比的投票。切换深色、浅色或暗色主题及自定义时间戳。导出高清PNG——无需注册，无水印，完全本地且私密。适用于广告创意、提案演示、YouTube缩略图和博客文章。
products.description: Free Tweet Mockup Generator – create realistic X/Twitter tweet mockups in seconds. Customize avatar, display name, @handle & verified badge (blue, gold or grey). Control views, likes, replies, reposts & bookmarks. Attach single images, 2–4 image grids or polls with vote %. Switch dark, light or dim theme + custom timestamp. Export high-res PNG – no signup, no watermark, fully local & private. Ideal for ad creatives, pitch decks, YouTube thumbnails & blog posts.

products.name: Notewarp
products.tagline: Turn messy thoughts into clear, reusable notes with AI
products.summaryZh: 用AI将杂乱思绪转化为清晰、可复用的笔记
products.descriptionZh: Notewarp将杂乱的捕捉内容转化为清晰、可复用的笔记。录制语音笔记、上传音频、粘贴文本、添加文件、扫描文本或保存链接，它都会将原始转录保留在整理后的笔记旁，并将同一来源重塑为摘要、行动项、邮件、学习笔记、大纲及自定义写作风格。通过标签、文件夹、搜索和置顶笔记整理一切；导出或分享一个精美的公开页面。适用于网页、iPhone、iPad和Mac。
products.description: Notewarp turns messy captures into clear, reusable notes. Record a voice note, upload audio, paste text, add a file, scan text, or save a link. It keeps the original transcript beside the cleaned note, then reshapes the same source into summaries, action items, emails, study notes, outlines, and custom writing styles. Organise everything with tags, folders, search, and pinned notes; export it or share a polished public page. Available on the web, iPhone, iPad, and Mac.

products.name: SEOBeast
products.tagline: Fully automated AI blogging that grows your SEO
products.summaryZh: 全自动AI博客写作，助力SEO增长
products.descriptionZh: SEOBeast是一款由AI驱动的SEO增长平台，可自动化整个内容工作流程。它能发现高价值关键词、研究竞争对手、生成SEO优化的文章、创建内部链接，并自动将内容发布到您的网站。从策略到排名，SEOBeast如同一个自主的SEO团队，以最少投入助您提升自然流量。
products.description: SEOBeast is an AI-powered SEO growth platform that automates your entire content workflow. It discovers high-value keywords, researches competitors, generates SEO-optimized articles, creates internal links, and publishes content automatically to your website. From strategy to ranking, SEOBeast works like an autonomous SEO team, helping you grow organic traffic with minimal effort.

products.name: GitDecode
products.tagline: AI-Powered Codebase Intelligence & Graph-Native AST Engine
products.summaryZh: AI驱动的代码库智能与图原生AST引擎
products.descriptionZh: AI驱动的代码库智能解析。GitDecode解析你的代码仓库，构建知识图谱，并通过交互式架构图和自然对话让你探索其中。
products.description: AI-powered codebase intelligence. GitDecode parses your repository, builds a knowledge graph, and lets you explore it through interactive architecture diagrams and natural conversation.

products.name: RoleSage
products.tagline: See the person in an avalanche of AI-polished applications
products.summaryZh: 在AI润色应用泛滥的浪潮中，看清一个人的真实面貌。
products.descriptionZh: AI润色后的申请材料让招聘团队比以往更难识别真实能力，也让优秀候选人更难展现自己。RoleSage为候选人提供可编辑、有证据支持的个人资料，关联实际活动、技能和成果。规模较小的招聘团队可在轻量级ATS中查看可解释的匹配区间、支持性证据、差距及面试问题。AI帮助整理背景信息；决策责任仍由人承担。
products.description: AI-polished applications make genuine capability harder than ever for hiring teams to identify - and for strong candidates to make visible. RoleSage gives candidates editable, evidence-backed profiles linked to real activities, skills, and outcomes. Smaller hiring teams inspect explainable match bands, supporting evidence, gaps, and interview questions inside a light ATS. AI helps organise context; people remain responsible for the decision.

products.name: Patch — Your Security Center
products.tagline: Lock down your digital life and stay on top of it.
products.summaryZh: 锁定你的数字生活，并时刻掌控它。
products.descriptionZh: Patch是一款适用于Mac和iPhone（正在App Store审核中）的安全应用，专为那些不愿在众多看似吓人的工具间来回切换以处理在线安全问题的用户设计。它能检测诈骗、发现泄露和重复使用的密码，帮助冻结信用并从数据经纪网站移除你的信息，所有这些功能集于一处，并配有安全顾问，可解答疑问并指导你如何解决问题。无需账户，且所有数据均不存储在我们的服务器上，因此无信息可窃取。
products.description: Patch is a security app for Mac and iPhone (in App Store review) designed for people who'd rather not bounce around a dozen scary-looking tools trying to deal with online security. It checks for scams, finds leaked and duplicate passwords, helps freeze your credit and remove you from data broker sites, all in one place, with a security advisor that answers questions and shows you how to fix things. No account needed, and nothing is kept on our servers, so there's nothing to steal.

products.name: Ryzio
products.tagline: Land more interviews.
products.summaryZh: 获得更多面试机会。
products.descriptionZh: Ryzio简化你的整个求职过程。免费创建并预览针对ATS优化的简历，将你的经验与具体职位描述进行对比，并利用可选的AI工具精准定制你的申请。此外，通过内置的申请追踪器，随时掌握每一个机会的动态。
products.description: Ryzio streamlines your entire job hunt. Create and preview ATS-optimized resumes for free, compare your experience against specific job descriptions, and leverage optional AI tools to perfectly tailor your application. Plus, keep tabs on every opportunity with our built-in application tracker.

products.name: Bank Statement Conversion
products.tagline: Convert PDF bank statements in seconds
products.summaryZh: 几秒内转换PDF银行对账单
products.descriptionZh: 将PDF银行对账单转换为CSV、Excel、QBO/QuickBooks、OFX、QFX、MT940、CAMT.053、Tally XML、BAI2、Sage、Xero、MYOB、DATEV和JSON格式，仅需30秒。支持PDF及扫描对账单的OCR识别。
products.description: Convert PDF bank statements to CSV, Excel, QBO/QuickBooks, OFX, QFX, MT940, CAMT.053, Tally XML, BAI2, Sage, Xero, MYOB, DATEV and JSON in 30 seconds. PDF and scanned statement OCR.
